plain_text:
Norris Goff appears in 652 recordings across 2 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1935 to 1953. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Norris Goff most often in Lum and Abner and The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show.

Characters credited here include Abner Peabody.
